title: DXF callback readers, projection limits, and parser-versus-render evidence
mode: Primary-source repository/documentation research plus local plan reconciliation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Broaden DXF comparison beyond full document codecs to callback-oriented readers and geometry projection/rendering tools.
Check whether these routes add source-inspectable evidence for specific DXF questions without conflating parser, writer, preservation, and rendering behavior.
Refine optional comparator admission while preserving local generated-control and fast-validation cadence.

sources.revision: Mutable documentation and QCAD master source reviewed 2026-10-19; exact commit not pinned
sources.observed: QCAD documents a supported read subset across DXF versions and DXF R15/AC1015 writing. The API dispatches supported information to user callbacks instead of retaining a complete document model. The visible HATCH dispatch calls handleHatchData while the ordinary addHatch call is commented out. LibrePCB identifies its dxflib repository as a fork of dxflib; it is not a separate implementation lineage. Binary-DXF behavior was not established.

sources.revision: Mutable README and repository metadata reviewed 2026-10-19; exact commit not pinned
sources.observed: The project identifies itself as a fork of skymakerolof/dxf and separates typed parsing, block denormalization, and SVG/polyline rendering. Its own matrix lists 3DFACE, ATTRIB/ATTDEF, MLEADER, OLEFRAME, REGION, TABLE, and MLINE as parsed but not rendered. The project describes its 2D coverage/rendering work as ongoing and does not document a DWG codec or DXF file writer in the reviewed scope.

sources.revision: Mutable current driver documentation/source reviewed 2026-10-19; KNOWN_ISSUES.md footer dated June 2018; executable version not tested
sources.observed: KNOWN_ISSUES.md lists MESH, MPOLYGON, RAY, TABLE, TOLERANCE, and XLINE as unsupported; records ambiguity over outline-versus-filled 3DFACE projection; names missing 3D/OCS support in DIMENSION, LEADER, and MULTILEADER projection; and notes omitted HATCH pattern fills and WIPEOUT image content. Because the file is dated 2018 and mutable, it is a scope warning rather than a measured result for a current GDAL binary.

localEvidence: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md already treats ezdxf as a strict DXF syntax/tag comparator and GDAL as an OGR projection, and separates native consumer acceptance from parser/output checks.
The plan's PAR-07/S8 matrix already distinguishes typed decode, raw retention, output membership, strict reopen, transformed/projected geometry, modeler semantics, and native acceptance.
The added candidate routes do not establish a local libdxfrw discrepancy. No candidate was run, and no expected geometry or parser result was derived from a peer output.

assessment.planImpact: Adds optional comparator boundaries for callback DXF readers and projection/rendering tools. Their evidence is admissible only for named stages they actually implement; it cannot promote writer, complete-graph, DWG, explicit 3D, ACIS, or native-acceptance claims.

method.kind: Read primary project documentation and relevant public source paths, then map declared/visible route boundaries to existing plan owners
method.limitations: Repository master/main pages and online documentation are mutable. QCAD dxflib was not pinned to an immutable commit and its binary-DXF behavior was not evaluated. DXF-Renewed's support matrix is project-authored. GDAL's KNOWN_ISSUES.md footer dates its content to 2018, so no statement is attributed to an untested current binary. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

implementationReadyChecks: Use authoritative format rules and local generated controls first; admit at most one optional comparator for a specific unresolved route question.
For callback readers, pin the source and record supported/unsupported callback outcomes; do not infer raw-document retention or writer behavior.
For viewers and OGR projections, account separately for parsed, retained, expanded/transformed, projected, and skipped source objects, with an explicit reason for every omission.
Use independently authored analytic expectations for geometry comparisons; visual plausibility and process exit are not semantic evidence.
Keep routine validation to the touched strict target, focused selector, owning existing CTest, and scoped diff check; reserve peer/native runs for named composed checkpoints.
Do not add external/customer drawings as fixtures; use local scratch-generated controls or already-admitted repository samples.
